boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations at Rancho San Rafael Regional Park, reached from the campus-adjacent North Sierra Street corridor.

cards.title: Rancho San Rafael Regional Park for trail time
cards.subtitle: North Sierra Street corridor, beside the UNR area
cards.notes: Enter from North Sierra Street and use the park map to choose a walking route; the county lists miles of trails among its amenities.
cards.short_summary: A large county park with mapped trails and varied landscape.
cards.evidence_claim: Washoe County identifies Rancho San Rafael as a 580-acre regional park with miles of trails and hiking/walking activities.
cards.access_notes: Address: 1595 North Sierra St., Reno, NV 89503. Check the county park page for rules, closures, and reservable areas.

cards.entity_name: Wilbur D. May Arboretum and Botanical Garden
cards.title: Wilbur D. May Arboretum for garden paths
cards.subtitle: North Sierra Street corridor, inside Rancho San Rafael
cards.notes: Use the Sierra Street entrance for the garden paths, and stay on marked routes rather than picking flowers, fruit, or foliage.
cards.short_summary: A free, year-round botanical garden within Rancho San Rafael.
cards.evidence_claim: Washoe County states that the Wilbur D. May Arboretum is inside Rancho San Rafael, open year-round during park hours, and free to visit.
cards.source_title: Visit the Wilbur D. May Arboretum
cards.access_notes: Located at Rancho San Rafael Park, 1595 N. Sierra Street. Special events may charge admission; routine arboretum access is free.

cards.title: Wilbur D. May Museum for a collection tour
cards.subtitle: North Sierra Street corridor, inside Rancho San Rafael
cards.notes: Check current museum offerings, then plan a self-guided visit or arrange a tour to focus on objects from Wilbur D. May’s collection.
cards.short_summary: A county museum presenting the collection of Reno philanthropist Wilbur D. May.
cards.evidence_claim: Washoe County describes guided museum tours focused on Wilbur D. May’s life and the items housed in the museum.
cards.access_notes: Inside Rancho San Rafael at 1595 N. Sierra Street; tours are by appointment. The county lists paid group rates.

cards.title: Herman's Pond for a mapped park stop
cards.subtitle: North Sierra Street corridor, inside Rancho San Rafael
cards.notes: Locate Herman’s Pond on the county trail map and fold it into a daytime park walk; follow posted pond and trail restrictions.
cards.short_summary: A named pond shown on Rancho San Rafael’s official trail map.
cards.evidence_claim: Washoe County’s Rancho San Rafael trail map labels Herman’s Pond within the park.
cards.source_title: Rancho San Rafael Park Trails Map
cards.access_notes: Access through Rancho San Rafael Regional Park at 1595 North Sierra Street; do not enter the water where signs prohibit it.

cards.title: Historic Ranch House for a park-history stop
cards.subtitle: North Sierra Street corridor, inside Rancho San Rafael
cards.notes: Find the Ranch House on the park map and view it as part of a wider loop through the grounds; confirm reservation status before events.
cards.short_summary: A named historic Ranch House within the regional park.
cards.evidence_claim: Washoe County lists the historic Ranch House among Rancho San Rafael Regional Park’s features and identifies it as a reservable building.
cards.access_notes: Inside the park at 1595 North Sierra Street. The building is reservable; contact the Park Ranger office for viewing arrangements.

cards.title: Basque Sheepherder Monument for a monument stop
cards.subtitle: North Sierra Street corridor, inside Rancho San Rafael
cards.notes: Use the park map to route to the Basque Sheepherder Monument, then continue on designated paths to another named park feature.
cards.short_summary: A named monument within Rancho San Rafael Regional Park.
cards.evidence_claim: Washoe County lists the Basque Sheepherder Monument among the destinations at Rancho San Rafael Regional Park.
cards.access_notes: Inside Rancho San Rafael at 1595 North Sierra Street; follow park rules and use the official park map for orientation.

cards.title: Chinese Pagoda Pavilion for a planned meetup
cards.subtitle: North Sierra Street corridor, inside Rancho San Rafael
cards.notes: Scout the Chinese Pagoda Pavilion during a park walk; for a group gathering, contact county reservations instead of assuming availability.
cards.short_summary: A named reservable pavilion in Rancho San Rafael.
cards.evidence_claim: Washoe County identifies the Chinese Pagoda Pavilion as a reservable group picnic area at Rancho San Rafael.
cards.access_notes: Inside the park at 1595 North Sierra Street. Reservation availability must be checked with Washoe County Park Reservations.

cards.title: Peavine Pavilion for a group picnic plan
cards.subtitle: North Sierra Street corridor, inside Rancho San Rafael
cards.notes: Locate Peavine Pavilion on the grounds before inviting a group, then use the county reservation contact to verify a date and permitted setup.
cards.short_summary: A named group-picnic pavilion at the regional park.
cards.evidence_claim: Washoe County lists Peavine Pavilion as a reservable group picnic area at Rancho San Rafael Regional Park.
cards.access_notes: Inside the park at 1595 North Sierra Street. Organized groups of 25 or more require a group-use permit.

cards.title: Lions Highland Pavilion for a reserved gathering
cards.subtitle: North Sierra Street corridor, inside Rancho San Rafael
cards.notes: Treat Lions Highland Pavilion as a reservation-based destination: check the county’s available dates before organizing a picnic or event.
cards.short_summary: A named reservable pavilion in the North Sierra Street park corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Washoe County lists Lions Highland Pavilion as a reservable group picnic area at Rancho San Rafael Regional Park.
cards.access_notes: Inside the park at 1595 North Sierra Street. Contact Washoe County Park Reservations to request availability.

cards.title: Nevada Farms and Families Area for a mapped detour
cards.subtitle: North Sierra Street corridor, inside Rancho San Rafael
cards.notes: Add this named park area to a self-guided loop, using the trail map and current county notices to choose your route and timing.
cards.short_summary: A named area of Rancho San Rafael, formerly called Great Basin Adventure.
cards.evidence_claim: Washoe County identifies Nevada Farms and Families Area, formerly Great Basin Adventure, as a feature of Rancho San Rafael Regional Park.
cards.access_notes: Inside Rancho San Rafael at 1595 North Sierra Street; check the official park page for current access and reservation information.
